description: Logic + paradoxes decomposed. Tarski hierarchy of truth, paraconsistent logic, dialetheism, surprise exam paradox, Newcomb's problem, Sleeping Beauty problem, two-envelope paradox, intuitionism.

sub_mechanisms.name: Tarski_truth_hierarchy
sub_mechanisms.definition: Tarski 1933: truth defined at higher meta-language level. Avoids liar.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of formal theory of truth. Object language + meta-language. Cost: artificial; natural language permits truth talk freely.

sub_mechanisms.name: paraconsistent_logic
sub_mechanisms.definition: Logic where contradictions don't entail everything. Reject ex falso quodlibet.
sub_mechanisms.why: Priest: dialetheism — some contradictions true. Handles liar + similar. Applied: AI knowledge bases, conflicting databases.

sub_mechanisms.name: dialetheism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Some contradictions true. Priest. Liar = true and false.
sub_mechanisms.why: Radical response to paradoxes. Cost: revision of logic. Strong philosophical defense + opposition.

sub_mechanisms.name: surprise_exam_paradox
sub_mechanisms.definition: Teacher: surprise exam this week. Reasoning eliminates each day. So no surprise possible. Yet exam happens.
sub_mechanisms.why: Self-defeating prediction. Variants in epistemic logic. Modern analyses: KK principle failure.

sub_mechanisms.name: Newcomb_problem
sub_mechanisms.definition: Take one box ($1M if predictor predicted you take one) or both ($1000 + the $1M box)? Two-boxer vs one-boxer.
sub_mechanisms.why: Decision theory. EDT vs CDT. Foundational puzzle. AI alignment: how should we reason about predictors?

sub_mechanisms.name: sleeping_beauty
sub_mechanisms.definition: Coin flip: heads = wake once; tails = wake twice. On waking: what credence in heads?
sub_mechanisms.why: Probabilistic puzzle. Halfers (1/2) vs thirders (1/3). Foundation of anthropic reasoning. AI: self-locating beliefs.

sub_mechanisms.name: two_envelope_paradox
sub_mechanisms.definition: One envelope has 2x money of other. Reason: switch expected value 1.25x. Should always switch?
sub_mechanisms.why: Paradox: symmetric reasoning. Resolution: improper prior or computational error. Foundation expected value reasoning.

sub_mechanisms.name: intuitionistic_logic
sub_mechanisms.definition: Reject law of excluded middle for undecidable. Brouwer + Heyting.
sub_mechanisms.why: Constructive math. Foundation of dependent type theory, Curry-Howard. Standard in CS theory + AI proof assistants.

sub_mechanisms.name: Bayesian_updating
sub_mechanisms.why: Rationality standard. Subjective Bayesianism (de Finetti, Savage). Foundation modern epistemology. Statistical practice.

sub_mechanisms.name: Curry_paradox
sub_mechanisms.definition: 'If this sentence is true, then 0 = 1.' Yields contradiction via conditional reasoning.
sub_mechanisms.why: Variant of liar. Avoids self-reference but yields contradiction. Foundation: even conditional + truth predicate problematic.

sub_mechanisms.name: monty_hall_problem
sub_mechanisms.definition: 3 doors, 1 prize. Pick one. Host opens an empty one. Switch?
sub_mechanisms.why: Counter-intuitive: switching wins 2/3. Foundation probabilistic reasoning. Information from host's action.

sub_mechanisms.name: Wittgenstein_rule_following
sub_mechanisms.definition: Kripke's Wittgenstein: no fact determines that I follow plus rather than 'quus'.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of meaning skepticism. Implications for AI: how do machines mean anything? Substrate's response: meaning is structural.

derivation_rules.name: Tarski_hierarchy_avoids_liar_at_cost
derivation_rules.why: Object language can't speak own truth. Cost: artificial; natural language permits. Foundation of formal semantics. Standard response.

derivation_rules.name: paraconsistency_lives_with_contradiction
derivation_rules.why: Classical: contradiction entails everything. Paraconsistent: bounded. Modern AI database integration uses. Practical.

derivation_rules.name: Newcomb_one_boxer_evidential
then: one-box (your action evidence for predictor's prior choice)
derivation_rules.why: EDT vs CDT divide. Many philosophers two-box (causally choose more); EDT one-boxers win $1M. Foundation decision theory.

derivation_rules.name: sleeping_beauty_thirder_more_accepted
derivation_rules.why: Self-locating uncertainty. Thirders dominate (Elga, Bostrom). Halfers (Lewis). Anthropic reasoning extension.

derivation_rules.name: intuitionistic_logic_constructive
derivation_rules.why: Strong notion: prove X by constructing. Foundation: dependent types, Coq, Lean. Constructive mathematics. Modern programming.
